in_marathi.name: Eekalabya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Skilled in all arts
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eekalabya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eekalabya is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Eka' meaning one and 'Labhya' meaning skill or capable. The name Eekalabya refers to a person who is skilled in all arts or sciences.
